sloka: अनुशिष्टा अस्मि मात्रा च पित्रा च विविध आश्रयम् ।न अस्मि सम्प्रति वक्तव्या वर्तितव्यम् यथा मया ॥२-२७-९॥
transliteration: anuśiṣṭā asmi mātrā ca pitrā ca vividha āśrayam ।na asmi samprati vaktavyā vartitavyam yathā mayā ॥2-27-9॥

translations.english: I have been so instructed by my parents about diverse duties in all stages of life that I need not be told anything (about my duties) now.
